# CrooHQ

> CrooHQ is a restaurant operations platform for multi-unit QSR and fast-casual groups, built by an operator.

CrooHQ brings scheduling, time clock, checklists, inventory, and hiring into one system, and syncs with the data you already have, like your POS. Founded by Jordan Andrian. Contact: jordan@croohq.com

- Home: https://croohq.com/
- Jobs: https://croohq.com/jobs
